properties.citation: Salem Chaker, « Amaziɣ (le/un Berbère) », Encyclopédie berbère, IV, 1986, p. 562-568, § 6: Amāheγ/Imūhaγ in the Ahaggar and the Ajjer, Amājeγ/Imājeγen in the Aïr and the south (Niger-Mali), Amāšeγ/Imūšaγ in the Adrar des Ifoghas. Region: Natural Earth Geography Regions AÏR MTS.
properties.derivation: Built by social/video/areas.mjs: the Natural Earth Geography Regions polygon AÏR MTS., on Africa's land (Africa's land is the union of the Natural Earth Admin 0 countries whose CONTINENT is Africa); on a 0.05° grid (cells whose centre falls inside), traced back as the cell boundary, simplified by Douglas–Peucker at 0.05° and rounded to 0.01°; parts and holes under 5000 km² dropped. Chaker gives Imajeghen for the Aïr and the south (Iwellemmeden, Kel Gress); the area draws the Aïr only, where Natural Earth has a region.
